import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    rates = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
    strategy = list(map(int, data[2 + n:2 + 2 * n]))
    # P: prefix of strategy*rate (profit), Q: prefix of rates.
    p = [0] * (n + 1)
    q = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        p[i + 1] = p[i] + strategy[i] * rates[i]
        q[i + 1] = q[i] + rates[i]
    base = p[n]
    best = base  # not modifying is allowed
    h = k // 2
    for l in range(n - k + 1):
        # Window [l, l+k): drop its old contribution, the second half all sells.
        v = base - (p[l + k] - p[l]) + (q[l + k] - q[l + h])
        if v > best:
            best = v
    print(best)


main()
